config.notes: RMIT course pages (www.rmit.edu.au/study-with-us/levels-of-study/...) are plain HTML with no page-data JSON. The at-a-glance panel prints both views: "Student type: Domestic International", then the domestic panel (Learning mode / Entry score / Duration / Fees / Next intake / Location), then the international panel in the same order. Every pattern is anchored on the SECOND "Learning mode:" after "Student type: Domestic International", i.e. the international panel. Fee = international "Fees: AU$NN,NNN (YYYY annual)" only; vocational "(YYYY total indicative)" amounts are not read. Intakes = international "Next intake:" months (research shows "Continuous", not read). IELTS = "IELTS (Academic): minimum overall band of X" in the English language requirements section. Central: English https://www.rmit.edu.au/study-with-us/international-students/apply-to-rmit-international-students/entry-requirements/english-requirements/english-language-proficiency-tests ; key dates https://www.rmit.edu.au/students/my-course/important-dates/2026/he and /2027/he (course pages print months directly, so no term_months). International view (5 Oct 13:02): RMIT prints the domestic and international panels in the same plain HTML (no address variant, no render needed), so page_view stays empty. Fee also reads the international "(YYYY total)" or "(YYYY total indicative)" amount when the international panel says "Duration: Full-time 1 year" (one year of full-time study = annual); totals for longer or unstated durations are not read. 15:34: fee_total + course_years read the international panel's vocational "AU$X (YYYY total indicative)" with "Duration: Full-time N year(s)"; the worker gives annual = total / N where no annual fee is printed (1-year totals are already read as fee). Not read: 6-month totals (below one year), and higher-education "(YYYY total)" figures on multi-year pages, which are per-year amounts mislabelled as total (BEng Honours 4 years AU$48,960, MR 2 years $44,160, the same as other pages' annual fees), so dividing them would understate the fee. 5 Oct 15:22: entry_requirement = first requirement sentence under "Entry requirements and admissions" (review only). exit_awards (review only) keeps the exit sentences and the page's "standard year of full-time study (96 credit points)"; RMIT exit wording has no full-time years, so the 5 Graduate Diploma exit awards (Arts Management, Justice and Criminology, Animation Games and Interactivity, Communication Design, Design Innovation and Technology) were set by hand at 1 year.
